messages:
Mira Lopez: Quick check — partners want a one-pager: slotting availability + embargo handshake for H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi. Can we agree owners and a tight timeline?
Caleb Wu: I'll own the slide and the marketplace reserve. Need SKU counts by region + any hold notes. @Vendor - NVID please confirm H200 shipping caveats.
Vendor - NVID: FYI: small microcode batch hold impacting a subset of H200 SKUs. Patch ETA 2026-04-21. APAC capacity will be lower week 1. Will post immutable tag + SBOM once validated.
Anya Petrov: SI checklist items draft: image tag + hash, SBOM, smoke script, device-plugin config, perf regression test (p95/p99), rollback steps. I'll drop the doc link shortly.
SI Lead - RJ: Integrators need a short canary playbook (how to run smoke, what metrics to watch). Keep it < 1 page. Also want an example curl and k8s check.
Caleb Wu: Proposed embargo rules: partners get 10-day marketing embargo; platform requires 72h image verification after tag + 48h staged canary (5% traffic) before GA. Triggers to abort: 5xx > 0.2% OR p99 > baseline*1.25 OR token-cost delta >20%. Agree?
Vendor - AMD: MI300 initial bins show thermal-limited throughput for sustained 48k seq. Recommend shipping mi300-quant for launch. We'll publish perf deltas for 2k/16k/48k by EOD.
Mira Lopez: Good. Add mandatory marketplace prereqs: immutable tag, signed SBOM, and test vectors. Legal requires partner marketing form 5 business days before public date.
Caleb Wu: I'll reserve promo slots in us-west & eu-west for proposed announce window 2026-04-25 to 2026-05-05, pending vendor artifacts.
Anya Petrov: Example smoke curl for SI playbook: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"mi300-quant","seq_len":2048,"requests":100}'
```
ops-bot: Canary job created by @Caleb Wu — job #7129 queued. Results will be posted to #eng-oncall.
SI Lead - RJ: For rollback wording to SIs: "If canary triggers fire, traffic will automatically shift to compatible fallback variants (e.g., H200 -> H100 or B200). Expect a short failover window; follow SI playbook for validation and re-integration."
Vendor - NVID: We'll aim to publish image tag + SBOM by 2026-04-20 EOD.
Vendor - AMD: Perf deltas and quant image tag by 2026-04-20 noon.
Mira Lopez: Action items: (1) Vendors drop tags/SBOMs (2) Caleb publish slide + reserve slots (3) Anya post SI checklist + playbook (4) Mira coordinate legal/marketing handshake. I'll run a 15m sync tomorrow 9am PT. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
